# color (linebender)

color 0.3.3, MIT or Apache-2.0 (`LICENSE-MIT`, `LICENSE-APACHE`), used
unmodified as a dependency with its `libm` feature: og-css parses
absolute CSS colours and converts and interpolates every CSS Color 4
space with it (`crates/og-css/src/color.rs`), and og-ui draws gradients
in a named colour space with its gradient approximation. Source is
available from https://github.com/linebender/color and
https://crates.io/crates/color/0.3.3.
